title: Coleus Velvet - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Vibrant Foliage
description:
Stunning Coleus with Rich Velvet Red Leaves for Containers and Gardens
KEY FEATURES
• Striking Red outlined lime coloured foliage
• Semi-dwarf mounding habit, ideal for containers and borders
• Heat and shade tolerant, low maintenance
• Long-lasting colour from spring to autumn
• Can be grown as a houseplant or summer annual
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides
Colour: Dark Red (Foliage)
Season: Spring, Summer, Autumn
Growth Habit: Mounding, Upright
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Partial shade to Full shade
Soil: Well-drained, rich soil
Watering: Regular, keep soil evenly moist
Spacing: 25-30cm
Height: 30-36cm
Spread: 25-30cm
Hardiness: 9b-11b (Perennial), UK Annual
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant 25-30cm apart in well-drained soil in a shady or partially shaded location.
• Water regularly, ensuring the soil remains evenly moist but not waterlogged.
• Pinch off any flowers that appear to encourage more vigorous foliage growth.
• For optimal colour, provide sufficient potassium in your feed if fertilising.
• If growing indoors, place in bright, indirect light and maintain consistent moisture.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
